title: Wed 11 Nov 2026: Hot US inflation lifts Fed hike bets, Treasury yields jump, Brent dips below $90, FCA plans to scrap the Certification Regime
summary: A hotter than expected American inflation report ends Wall Street's rebound and sends Treasury yields sharply higher, while Brent briefly falls below ninety dollars on Iran hopes. We look at the Fed, Bank of England and ECB all leaning towards higher rates, the FCA's proposal to remove the Certification Regime under its Senior Managers reforms, the Bank of England's warning on AI and cyber risk, RBC's deal for Yarra Capital, State Street and Van Lanschot Kempen's active ETFs, and easing pressure on private credit withdrawals. Plus three COO action points, including today's US Veterans Day bond market closure, and the diary.
